City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
JANUARY 26, 2010
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL MEMBERS: Argudo, Mendoza, Solis, Holloway, Lujan
COMMISSIONERS: Argudo, Mendoza, Solis, Holloway, Lujan
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION TO DAVID FA'ANUNU FOR COMPLETION OF EAGLE SCOUT PROJECT
Presentation - David Fa' Anunu
PRESENTATION OF MILITARY BANNER CERTIFICATES
Presentation - Military Banner Certificates
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF JANUARY 12, 2009
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the regular Meeting of January 12, 2010.
A-1 MIN 01-12-10 CC Reg
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE EXTENDING BY 12 MONTHS THE TERMS AND PROVISIONS OF ORDINANCE NO. 09-882, ESTABLISHING A TEMPORARY MORATORIUM ON ESTABLISHMENT AND OPERATION OF LARGE FAMILY DAY CARE HOMES WITHIN THE CITY'S RESIDENTIAL ZONES.
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) open the public hearing; 2) take public testimony; 3) close public hearing; 4) adopt Urgency Ordinance No. 10-896 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente extending by 12 months the terms and provisions of Ordinance No. 09-882, establishing a temporary moratorium on establishment and operation of large family day care homes in City's residential zones
B-1 Large Family Day Care Homes Moratorium Report
B-1 Large Family Day Care Homes Moratorium Ordinance - Attachment A
NEW BUSINESS
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT FOR THE LOCAL TAXPAYER, PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRANSPORTATION ACT OF 2010 (Requested by Council Member Holloway)
None. However, should the City Council wish to support the initiative, the Resolution provided by the Californians to Protect Local Taxpayers and Vital Services should be adopted.
E-4 Local Taxpayer Act- Holloway Request
E-4 Local Taxpayer Act -Reso- Attachment A
E-4 Local Taxpayer Act Summary- Attachment B
E-4 Local Taxpayers Act Advocacy Paper- Attachment C
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
None.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1266 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2009-10
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 10-4846, approving Warrant Register No. 1266.
D-1 Resolution Warrant Register #1266
D-2
APPROVAL OF THE MONTHLY TREASURER'S/FINANCIAL REPORT FOR NOVEMBER 30, 2009
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Monthly Treasurer's/Financial Report for the November 30, 2009.
D-2 Fin City Financial Report 11-30-09
D-2 Fin City Financial Report - Attach A-G
D-3
APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE PUBLIC SAFETY SERVICES BUDGET FOR ANIMAL CONTROL SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 10-4847, authorizing a transfer of $71,450 from the general fund to account 11-4210-3113-21 to cover the County's projected fees for animal care and control services for the remainder of the fiscal year.
D-3 Public Contract Services Budget Adjustment Report
D-3 Public Contract Services RESO - Attach A
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF CHANGING THE CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION DATE FROM NOVEMBER TO APRIL OF EACH YEAR
It is recommended that the City Council 1) waive the reading of Ordinance No. 10-894 and read by title only; and 2) introduce Ordinance No. 10-894, amending Chapter 2.04 of the La Puente Municipal Code, changing the reorganization date of the City Council from November to April of each year.
E-1 Change Reorg Date Report
E-1 Change ReOrg Date - Attach A
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF AN URGENCY ORDINANCE ESTABLISHING A TEMPORARY MORATORIUM ON AUTOMOBILE DEALERSHIPS IN THE CITY'S C-2 (GENERAL COMMERCIAL) ZONE PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 65858
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Urgency Ordinance No. 10-897, making findings and establishing a temporary moratorium on the issuance of any zoning permit, use permit, or other entitlement for the establishment and operation of automobile dealerships in the C-2 (General Commercial) zones.
E-2 Urgency Moratorium Automobile Dealerships C-2 Zone - Report
E-2 Urgency Moratorium Auto Dealerships - Attachment A
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENTS TO: PLANNING COMMISSION, PARKS & RECREATION COMMISSION, PUENTE PRIDE COMMITTEE AND EDUCATION COMMISSION
It is recommended that the City Council make appointments to fill scheduled vacancies to subject commissions and committees.
E-3 Committees & Commissions Annual Recruitment Report
E-3 Committies & Commissions - Attach A
E-3 Committies & Commissions - Attach B
E-3 Committies & Commissions - Attach C
E-3 Committies & Commissions - Attach D
E-3 Committies & Commissions - Attach E
AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
COUNCIL AB1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
